name: Laplacian Shading
definition: Visualizes the surface Laplacian by normalizing to [-1, 1], flipping sign, mapping to [0, 1], and applying gamma correction.
summary: Laplacian Shading visualizes the second-order derivative of a Signed Distance Field to highlight local geometry's concavity and convexity, distinguishing itself from normal shading by revealing curvature details.
